whyUs.title: Reasons why our customers feel satisfied and happy

card2.title: Increase conversion rate

card3.title: Scalable model

card4.title: Transparent service

ourServices.title: Here you find all you need to make your business thrive

item1.title: Social advertising
item1.content: Creative strategies and different formats according to each phase of the funnel, with a design and writing that captures the attention of your target audience on the networks and induces conversion.

popup.text1: Millions of small and large companies connect with people through social media ads building lasting relationships. But in a context in which advertisers are increasing and users are resisting more to advertising, to achieve profitability without a good strategy is a matter of chance.
popup.text2: These years at Kliv, we have been finding the ideal formula for a variety of companies, helping them achieve their commercial objectives and guaranteeing return on investment with the philosophy of performance marketing.
popup.text4: The basic effectiveness of any campaign lies in its components being strategically aligned towards the same North: the SMART* objective, the compass that guides the execution of the entire process and allows performance to be evaluated. We forge strategies that respond to this objective and the available resources and document all its elements in a campaign sheet available to all the teams involved to operate with consistency.
popup.text5: SMART: Specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and temporal.
popup.text7: Based on the principle that two companies are never the same, the advertising platforms were designed to adapt to a variety of objectives and strategies in each phase of the conversion funnel, with great versatility in their advertising formats. At Kliv, we identify the optimal one for each campaign.
popup.text9: We tell the story of your company or product in attractive and effective ways, capturing the attention of your target audience and encouraging them to take specific actions. The editorial team and graphic and audiovisual designers work shoulder to shoulder with the performance marketing team, aligned in the strategy to optimize results.
popup.text11: The greatest potential of advertising platforms is set in their ability to segment and manage audiences. Ironically, it is usually the most underutilized tool, limiting its use to segmentation by interests that, by themselves, are not entirely accurate. At Kliv, we generate dynamic and customized audiences for each phase of the funnel, identifying behavioral patterns in real-time through the web tracking pixel and lookalike segmentations that allow us to find the people most likely to perform the desired actions.
popup.text13: In addition to optimizing audience management, the “web beacon” allows you to monitor the performance of each campaign with redirection to the web. By setting up custom events and parameters, we measure all the specific actions that visiting users take, with a particular action as the conversion goal.
popup.text15: Setting advertising bids based on cost per impressions or clicks (CPM or PPC) does not guarantee profitability, since they are not metrics linked to conversions or profit margin. In contrast, the acquisition bidding (CPA) strategy regulates that the advertising cost does not exceed the amount willing to invest for each result and optimizes it over time.
popup.text17: The Facebook Ads experimentation tools (A/B Testing + Exclusion Testing), added to the methodologies that we implement at Kliv (Smoke Test, Fake Door, Flintstone, among others) allow us to test hypotheses or answer specific questions concerning business objectives, helping to identify opportunities for improvement and insights to optimize communication.
popup.text19: We export the data to a tool that allows you to create interactive and customizable panels (Data Studio), making it easier to read and understand the results accurately and in real-time. Correctly interpreting the metrics is essential to know the impact of the campaigns related to the stated objectives. These metrics are monitored periodically to determine if they are on track or if any adjustments are necessary.

item2.title: Google Advertising
item2.content: Ads on search engines, Google Maps, YouTube, advertising spaces on associated websites and applications, reaching your target audience at the right time.

popup.text2: Sponsored results in the Google search engine just when the user shows interest in your products or services; guiding them towards the conversion at that precise moment, whether it is performing a specific action on your website, visiting your networks, making a call or heading to your premises with Google Maps.
popup.text4: Reach your target audience while they browse websites, use apps, or check their Gmail, with images or GIF banners. This is ideal for early stages of the funnel or aimed at those who have already taken action on your website.
popup.text6: Video ads on the YouTube platform generate a degree of emotional involvement with the content like no other medium can. Through creative audiovisual messages that delight, connect with your audience and induce them to take a particular action, either at that moment or later.
popup.text8: Exclusive ads for e-commerce, made up of tabs with images, prices and other information relevant to users looking for your product, with a direct link to the shopping cart on your website.
popup.text10: It puts you on the map, allowing them to find you from the Google search engine or Google Maps and, with just one click, call you, visit your website or arrive at your location with GPS. Turn strangers into customers by claiming your profile and sharing photos of your products, menus, promotions, opening hours and answering queries, reviews or reservations.

item3.title: Email Marketing
item3.content: Newsletters, transactional, promotional and sequential e-mails, converting contacts into clients and then into ambassadors of your brand.

popup.text1: Email marketing is a communication tool that allows you to contact your target audience through their e-mail, with personalized messages throughout the conversion funnel.
popup.text2: At Kliv, we use a powerful e-mail marketing software with built-in design, automation, analysis and contact segmentation tools.
popup.text4: Send periodically newsletters of interest to your subscribers, with relevant content in their market. It fulfils a loyalty and brand positioning function while generating traffic to the company's website.
popup.text6: Automatic e-mails in response to the user's interaction with your website or application. Purchase confirmation, abandoned cart reminder, new user, password change, download of material, among others.
popup.text8: E-mails aimed at achieving sales through a call to action and concise offer, segmented by categorized contact lists that allow you to send personalized offers.
popup.text10: Automated e-mail sequences guide the user through each phase of the conversion funnel, building a personalized relationship from the moment the first contact is made. They learn more about your brand and products, make a purchases, recommend you and become a regular buyer.

item4.title: Social media management
item4.content: Relevant content is adjusted to the interests and needs of your target audience, creating valuable environments that strengthen the bond with your brand.

popup.text1: Strategic social media management is an essential component in all phases of the conversion funnel. It should not be applied as an isolated strategy, but rather it should be planned following the rest of the company's digital strategies.
popup.text2: At Kliv, we develop quality content aligned with specific objectives, which adjust to the interests of your buyer persona and transmit the values and identity of your brand. In addition, we monitor your social media and promote a close relationship with your audience, responding to comments and answering queries.
popup.text5: Regular presence through posts that provide value contributes to the notoriety, positive recognition and distinction of your brand. People tend to consume brands that are familiar to them.
popup.text7: Encouraging natural interaction strengthens the audience's commitment to your brand, creating links beyond the purchase-sale relationship. Those who feel integrated, listened to and involved will be those who, out of their conviction, will share the content and recommend your brand on their networks.
popup.text9: Instructing about the specifications of your products or services and answering your customers' frequently asked questions will make it easier for them to make the purchasing decision and their satisfaction will be greater, since they will know in detail what they purchased.
popup.text11: Relevant content generates quality traffic, reinforcing the positioning of your social media and allowing your commercial proposals to reach more potential clients.
popup.text13: Organic communication eliminates the advertising tone by creating relationships of trust through recurring qualified content that does not simply seek to sell, but rather to provide value and generate conversation with the audience. Consumers gravitate towards brands that reflect credibility.
popup.text15: It is always more profitable to sell to a current customer than to look for a new one. Relevant content helps to keep your customers engaged with your brand in the long term.
popup.text17: With strategies planned accordingly, social media management deals to reduce the cost per acquisition of paid campaigns by optimizing conversions; since users tend to investigate beyond the advertisement that caught their attention before making the purchase decision.
popup.text19: We export the data to a tool that allows you to create interactive and customizable panels (Data Studio), making it easier to read and understand the results accurately and in real-time. Correctly interpreting the metrics is essential to know the impact of the campaigns in relation to the stated objectives. They are monitored periodically to determine if they are on track or if any adjustments are necessary.
popup.text22: Starting from a complete diagnosis of the current situation of your brand and the competition on social media, we define specific objectives and identify the target audience, the personality archetype and aesthetics according to the global communication strategy.
popup.text24: With the bases and the direction defined, we come up with valuable content and promotional actions that we schedule for the entire month; always involving an internal manager of your company in the process to guide us from their perspective and criteria.
popup.text26: With a content grid in hand and a lot of creativity, we design pieces that impact and write copies that persuade, appropriate to your brand's identity. Before posting, each graph, video and text is shared for validation and adjustments.
popup.text28: According to the scheduled plan, posts are programed with their respective piece and copy, monitoring their performance day by day. And beyond what is scheduled, we remain receptive to spontaneous content that adds value, especially for stories. In addition, comments and private messages are answered from 9 a. m. to 6 p. m. (GMT-3), or they are assigned to a company manager when necessary. Active listening predominates in identifying valuable insights, detecting opportunities and avoiding conflicts.
popup.text30: At the end of each monthly period, performance is analyzed in contrast to the objectives set, presenting a quantitative and qualitative report, along with a proposal for improvement for the following month.

item5.title: Web design
item5.content: Web platforms optimized to generate conversion actions, with agile and secure navigability, excellent organic indexing in search engines and adaptability to multiple devices. See more

popup.text1: At Kliv, we have a team of “full stack developers”, that is, programmers with a very complete technical profile who work in front and backend without using web design systems (such as Wix or WordPress), enabling personalized and functional developments, 100 % tailored to the requirements of your company.
popup.text2: Unique and exclusive interfaces, adapted to the identity of your brand.
popup.text3: Platforms optimized to generate conversion actions, without limitations in their functionalities.
popup.text4: Efficient pages that adapt to all devices and browsers, updated with the latest technology, guaranteeing agile and safe navigation.
popup.text5: Optimization for search engines, respecting quality standards that favor organic indexing, increasing visibility.
popup.text6: Along with your site, you receive webmail boxes integrated with your company's domain.
popup.text7: We take care of integrating it into Google Analytics, so you can analyze user behavior on the site, demographic information, interests, flow of visits, etc.
popup.text9: We divide the process into 2 stages. First, we design the website, and once we have your final approval, we move forward with the programming.
popup.text11: We take care of registering and hosting the domain (yoursite.com) as well as your website files, with monthly backups to guarantee the security of the content.
popup.text13: You have our technical support for any changes/innovations that you want to implement within the site.
popup.text14: * The Domain, Hosting and Maintenance have a monthly or annual cost depending on the package you choose and the quotes at the time.

item6.title: Graphic and audiovisual design
item6.content: Corporate identity manual, logos, brochures, infographics, and motion graphic animations.

popup.text1: Graphic and audiovisual elements are essential in the commercial strategy to reach your audience in a dynamic and captivating way that transmits your brand’s identity.
popup.text2: At Kliv, we work with audiovisual design and production teams experienced in the advertising field with a performance orientation.
popup.text4: This includes the main graphic elements of a brand, explaining how they should be applied in each case. An essential tool that guarantees cohesion in visual communication, with homogeneity in any medium, no matter who uses it.
popup.text5: From the development of the concept, naming and logo of the brand, its composition and correct and incorrect applications, defined colors, primary and complementary typography, and all applications, whether digital pieces (such as avatars for social media or e-mail signatures) or printed (business cards, letterhead, etc.)
popup.text6: Before moving forward with any advertising action, we suggest developing an updated corporate identity manual as a fundamental basis for communication, which remains a tool for your brand.
popup.text8: Logo design consists of graphically representing the values, ideals and characteristics of a brand, using a symbol, image or typography that is memorable to its potential customers.
popup.text9: * The identity manual includes the design or redesign of a logo for your brand, but we also work on it separately.
popup.text11: Layout and composition of any media that combines text and images, whether presentation folders, tri-fold brochures, single-sheet brochures or infographics, among others. It is always sought to be attractive and functional for the reader, achieving perfect harmony between format and content.
popup.text13: Product packaging is a resource that is used as a cover letter to transmit an attractive message and differentiate the product from the competition, and guarantee the protection of the product, allowing its storage and distribution. Design of boxes, bags, labels, printing on packaging and papers, among others.
popup.text15: Videos are created with images, photographs, texts and icons, which are given movement through digital animation. An ideal technique to express complex ideas easily and entertainingly, capturing greater public attention and increasing message retention. It is commonly used in presentations, government propaganda, and for advertising purposes.

howWeWork.title: A working method that allows us to obtain the expected results
howWeWork.step1Content: Starting from a 360-degree survey of your company and the market, we design a 100 % custom conversion funnel, adjusted to your resources and objectives.
howWeWork.step2Content: We carry out what was planned, assembling all the elements that make up each campaign coordinated between our interdisciplinary team.
howWeWork.step3Content: We monitor key performance indicators (KPI) daily, making adjustments based on the results obtained to improve effectiveness and lower costs.
howWeWork.step4Content: At the end of the campaigns, the resulting metrics are presented in interactive panels, allowing them to be interpreted and opportunities for improvement detected for the following period.

question1.title: What packages or how many campaigns are right for my organization?
question1.content: We know that each organization is a whole new world, with specific objectives, business processes and resources, to which a tailored service structure corresponds. Contact us to receive free advice and determine the ideal package for your company.

question2.title: What does the campaign rate include?
question2.content:
Advertising platforms are divided into 3 levels: campaigns, ad sets and ads. Each campaign is charged for monthly periods and responds to a specific advertising objective and phase of the conversion funnel. 

*Does not include advertising investment. That is the responsibility of the client. 
*Includes multimedia designs and the report panel.

question3.title: What payment methods do you accept and how do you invoice?
question3.content:
- Bank transfer in the US (USD)
- Bank transfer in Argentina (ARS) 
- Binance Pay (USDT) 

Kliv LLC Agency Invoice

question4.title: When are services paid?
question4.content:
- Monthly services: 100 % advance payment for starting up, and then within the first 10 calendar days of each monthly period.
- One-time services: 50 % advance payment and 50 % upon delivery.

question5.title: What is the period of the contracts?
question5.content: The minimum contractual period is 4 consecutive months. Thereafter, the contract is automatically renewed each month until either party terminates by notifying you at least 20 days prior to the expiration of the current monthly period.

question6.title: Is there a guarantee of results?
question6.content: It is important to note that magic formulas do not exist, since each company is unique, but we know the modus operandi to find the correct path that leads to tangible and monetizable results. It is a process of continuous experimentation, with its errors and successes as a guide, achieving profitability in the medium term and seeking to maximize it over time. At Kliv, we trust our work processes with a focus on results, as well as our multidisciplinary team and years of experience; always ready for new challenges.

question7.title: Do you offer discounts for non-profit organizations?
question7.content: Sure! At KLIV, we recognize and value the work of non-profit organizations. Contact us for more details on how we can collaborate.
